description: Harbor's swagger declares getVulnerabilitiesAddition's 200 body as `type: string`, but src/server/v2.0/handler/artifact.go (goharbor/harbor v2.15.4, read 2026-11-01) writes json.Marshal of a map keyed by report MIME type, with Content-Type application/json. It is a JSON document, whose shape depends on the requested MIME type.
